trigger.library_file_added: When a file is added to the library

pickRoom: Choose a channel first: the work runs there and the results go there
intro: At a set time, or when something happens in the project, the AI teammate in a channel starts on its own, puts the results in the channel and notifies you. Say “sum up progress every Monday morning” in a channel and {name} creates one too — saving it is what sets it running.

spend.hint: What this rule took from the team's credits this month. Model calls only — cloud compute is not counted.

records.title: {title} · Run history
records.missedOnly: Only the runs that didn't go

emptyHint: Click “New”, or ask the AI teammate in a channel to draft one

tab.label: The two pages for a new routine

weekly.title: Weekly report
weekly.goal: Sum up what the channels finished last week on one page
weekly.note: One block per channel: what got finished first, then what is still waiting. Only this week's work, no looking further back. The result goes in the channel's files.

quiz.title: Weekly quiz
quiz.goal: Write a short quiz on what was covered this week
quiz.note: One file for the questions and one for the answers, both in the “Weekly quiz” folder in the channel. Ten questions at most, drawn from what came up in the channel and the library this week. The answer file says why for each one.

daily.title: Daily digest
daily.goal: Put today's decisions and loose ends from the channel on one page
daily.note: Two parts: what got decided, and what is still waiting. Say who decided each one, and who each waiting one is stuck on. On a quiet day, write one line saying so; don't pad it out.

archive.title: File it away
archive.goal: When a new file lands in the library, move it to the right folder and write one line on what it is for
archive.note: A folder per project; the one-line description goes at the top of the file. If it is unclear where a file belongs, leave it alone and ask in the channel.

unit.title: Unit summary
unit.goal: Sum up the key points of one learning task on one page
unit.note: Only what was really learned in this task: new concepts, how to use them, the snags hit. Check it against the task's existing library documents and don't repeat what is already there. The result goes in the task's deliverables.

form.name: Title
form.goalPlaceholder: e.g. Sum up this week's finished tasks, work in progress and blockers across channels in a one-page weekly report
form.notePlaceholder: e.g. List results per channel; only files in the library
form.autoHint: {agent} fills the blanks from the goal, and starts running once that is done.
form.goalRequired: The goal is required: it is what {agent} works from.
form.weekdaysRequired: Pick a day: a weekly run has to name which day.

deleteBody: It stops running and its run history is deleted too; result files already in the channel are kept
roomsFailed: Failed to load this project’s channels
